title: Acid-base synergistic activation of coal gasification fine slag into hierarchical porous carbon for enhanced Cr(VI) adsorption and reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26473-26487
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02711C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lijuan Bai, Hua Wang, Kaipeng Guo, Xia Li, Kaiwen Bai, Zhengyan Shi, Rui Dang
Hierarchical porous carbon from coal gasification fine slag via acid–alkali activation exhibited a high surface area (630.3 m2 g−1) and Cr(VI) adsorption capacity of 179.9 mg g−1 through pore filling, electrostatic attraction and redox reactions.
